verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distro, so its programmatic surface is the official `omarchy` CLI rather than an HTTP API. The manual says the system "can also" be controlled through the CLI, specifically to help an AI agent with customization and configuration. Documented commands mirror UI actions such as reminders, snapshots and the Windows key, but nothing claims every menu or GUI action has a CLI equivalent, and no HTTP API or OpenAPI spec exists (all probe paths returned 404). Missing for 10: documented full parity between Omarchy Menu/GUI actions and the CLI, a complete CLI command reference in evidence, and hands-on corroboration of agent-driven control.
